structural_bottlenecks.note: 69 necessary dependencies remain in the structural map. Two unique bottlenecks now have independent PIT SEC tension evidence; this is still not a calibrated bottleneck probability.

dependencies.name: AI Accelerators
dependencies.reason: Training and inference at scale require accelerator compute capacity.

dependencies.name: High Bandwidth Memory
dependencies.reason: High-throughput accelerator workloads depend on memory bandwidth.

dependencies.name: Grid Power Capacity
dependencies.reason: Large-scale compute requires reliable electrical power capacity.

dependencies.name: Power Transformers
dependencies.reason: New high-load compute facilities require grid interconnection and transformer capacity.

dependencies.name: Data Center Cooling
dependencies.reason: Dense compute cannot operate continuously without thermal management.

dependencies.name: High-Speed Networking
dependencies.reason: Distributed compute clusters depend on high-bandwidth interconnects.

dependencies.name: Advanced Semiconductor Packaging
dependencies.reason: Leading accelerators depend on advanced packaging capacity.

dependencies.name: Copper
dependencies.reason: Power distribution and data-center electrical infrastructure require substantial copper content.

dependencies.name: Actuators and Motors
dependencies.reason: Robotic motion requires actuators and motors.

dependencies.name: Batteries
dependencies.reason: Mobile autonomous systems require onboard energy storage.

dependencies.name: Power Electronics
dependencies.reason: Electric actuation requires power conversion and control electronics.

dependencies.name: Semiconductors
dependencies.reason: Autonomous machines require onboard compute and control semiconductors.

dependencies.name: Sensors
dependencies.reason: Physical autonomy depends on perception and feedback sensors.

dependencies.name: Rare Earth Magnets
dependencies.reason: High-performance compact motors often depend on permanent magnets containing rare-earth materials.

dependencies.name: Cell Manufacturing Capacity
dependencies.reason: Storage deployment requires scalable cell manufacturing capacity.

dependencies.name: Grid Interconnection
dependencies.reason: Grid-scale storage cannot monetize without interconnection capacity.

dependencies.name: Battery Materials
dependencies.reason: Electrochemical storage requires active-material feedstocks whose exact mix depends on chemistry.

dependencies.name: Copper
dependencies.reason: Battery systems and grid interconnection require conductive copper.

dependencies.name: Rare Earth Separation and Refining
dependencies.reason: Mined rare-earth material requires separation and refining before high-value use.

dependencies.name: Permanent Magnet Manufacturing
dependencies.reason: Magnet applications require downstream alloying and magnet manufacturing capacity.

dependencies.name: Lithography Equipment
dependencies.reason: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing requires lithography capability.

dependencies.name: Advanced Semiconductor Packaging
dependencies.reason: Advanced chips increasingly require complex packaging and integration.

dependencies.name: Semiconductor Materials and Gases
dependencies.reason: Wafer fabrication depends on specialty materials and process gases.

structural_company_bridge.note: Explicit SEC supply-side wording. Only AMD, LRCX and ETN currently sit on bottlenecks with independent tension evidence.

supplier_candidates.why: SEC evidence describes semiconductor process solutions, HBM 3D-stacking and wafer-level packaging.
SEC evidence states AMD products include AI accelerators, CPUs and GPUs.
SEC evidence explicitly describes electrical-power products sold into data centers, utilities and other power-demand markets.
SEC evidence describes network-interface cards, switches and subsystems used in AI data centers.
SEC evidence describes Dell's data-center networking portfolio and switches.
SEC evidence describes HBM and DRAM test solutions supporting AI compute deployments.

bottleneck_forecast.note: Observed tension is descriptive. ORACLE still refuses to assign P(bottleneck) without historical realized outcomes.

economic_capture.note: Supplier role plus bottleneck tension is not enough. V1 requires at least two independent PIT SEC documents with both commercial pull and ability/supply evidence before even calling capture evidence backed.

market_expectations.note: Reverse DCF measures what FCF growth the market price implies. FCF5Y_RIDGE_PIT_V1 improved holdout MAE versus baseline but failed probability calibration, so no P(fundamentals exceed expectations) is emitted.
